title: Matched primary evaluation and submission controls

definitions.bootstrap: 10,000 paired complete-game draws per cell, seed 20261122. Intervals condition on the fitted policies.
definitions.questions_per_win: Counted questions on winning games divided by wins. A win at an ambiguous state may be lucky.
definitions.joint_wins: The compared policies win these same cases. The saved question gap sums the per-case differences.
definitions.repeated_splits: A legal question with the same truth mask as a previous question, or its complement.
definitions.flipped_answers: Observed flips among valid sampled yes/no turns. Which turns are observed depends on the policy.
definitions.reward: Mean of the saved game returns in that group. Noise comparisons are descriptive.
definitions.halving: Format failure on noiseless animals N=32. The tested wording produced 262 invalid questions out of 280 and no final guesses. A working prompted-halving baseline remains untested.
